issues.description: References 'assess-model-monitoring-001', pointing to an assessment ID rather than a capability or prerequisite ID.
References assessment IDs instead of capabilities or prerequisites.

technical_review.notes: Assessments incorrectly use other assessments as capability references[cite: 16].

special_question.notes: The modular breakdown of signal identification, cause differentiation, and action proposal builds a robust cognitive schema[cite: 16].

rubric_scores.rationale: Criteria are highly measurable, particularly the identification and classification steps[cite: 16].
The written tasks perfectly map to the analytical and evaluative demands of the objectives[cite: 16].
Structured written responses provide solid evidence of analytical reasoning, though a live dashboard interaction would offer higher fidelity[cite: 16].
Cognitive verbs match the requested performances and assessment tasks perfectly[cite: 16].
Prerequisites effectively map out the prior knowledge required to succeed in a time-constrained lesson[cite: 16].
The progression strictly adheres to logical dependencies (signals -> causes -> actions)[cite: 16].
Lessons heavily feature worked examples and independent practice that directly mirror the assessment formats[cite: 16].
The 60-minute limit is tight for covering all three modules, but the reliance on established prerequisites mitigates this risk[cite: 16].
Instruction is precisely targeted to the required performances[cite: 16].
Requires resolving schema reference errors within the assessments array.

prerequisite_acceptance.notes: The prerequisites are appropriately scoped as entry conditions[cite: 16].

edit_effort.notes: Fix the required_capability_refs in assess-model-monitoring-002 and 003 to point to prerequisite capabilities or objectives rather than other assessments.

pedagogical_review.overall_notes: A well-designed instructional artifact with a strong pedagogical sequence, marred only by minor technical schema references[cite: 16].
